description: Returns the most recent SEC Form 4 insider trading alerts and 8-K Item 5.02 officer/director change alerts across the EDGAR Alert universe, ranked by recency. By default only returns high-confidence alerts (signal_score >= 80); lower minScore to widen results. Use this for 'what's happening right now' questions. For complex multi-filter searches (by ticker, sector, market cap, date range), use edgaralert_search_alerts instead.

limit.description: Maximum number of alerts to return (1-200).

minScore.description: Minimum signal_score, inclusive. Defaults to 80 (high-confidence only). Pass 0 to see all alerts.

planned.description: true = only planned/10b5-1/scheduled trades. false = only likely-discretionary trades. Omit for both.

scope.description: "watchlist" restricts to the user's default ticker list; "universe" (default) applies no restriction.

side.description: Filter by transaction direction. Omit or "ALL" returns both.

name: edgaralert_get_latest_alerts
title: Get latest insider trading alerts
